messages:
maya: Noticing the p95 delta between service A and variant B looks inverted on the compare view. p95 lower for the variant even though p50 drifted up. Anyone else?
eli: I see that. prob due to sample origin collapse when we merged route tags. sample_count overlay shows variant B has ~15 samples only.
sam: Could be sampling bias — variant is only hitting cold-cache nodes (KV miss). If tail samples are sparse it's easy to get weird pctl.
jordan: UX idea: show per-percentile delta markers + an inline sample_count overlay. Also a small strip that visually indicates confidence.
maya: Agree. The legend currently shows "service" and "route" but doesn't indicate sample origin (live vs cached vs replay). That's confusing when comparing rollouts.
eli: If we show sample-origin in legend, we should grey out low-sample percentiles and not show their delta as part of the main % change. Quick backend change: add count and pctl and mark entries with cnt < 100.
sam: ```
-- clickhouse-ish example
SELECT service, variant, quantile(0.95)(latency) AS p95, count() AS cnt
FROM requests
WHERE timestamp >= now() - 1h
GROUP BY service, variant
HAVING cnt >= 100
```
maya: We can't drop those cohorts completely — small-sample signals are useful for regressions. Proposal: keep them visible but show a ⚠️ and exclude them from the aggregated delta calc.
jordan: Important: rollout gating uses that delta calc. If we exclude small cohorts blindly we could miss real canary regressions on low-traffic segments. We need a `delta_confidence` metric (bootstrap / CI).
sam: Bootstrap every chart update will be heavy. Maybe approximate via t-statistic using variance estimate or an analytic CI for the quantile (asymptotic).
eli: Another factor: routing policy fallbacks change tail behavior. When requests fall back to cheaper variants, the p99 can move independently. We should overlay routing-policy timeline on the latency chart.
maya: Yes — add vertical event strips for config changes (routing/quota/rollout) pulled from audit logs. Makes it easier to correlate spikes.
console-bot: Note: New event tracing API available at /api/v1/console/events — returns [{event_type, timestamp, meta}].
maya: Perfect, we can pull that and render event markers.
jordan: I'll prototype: delta strip + sample overlay + event markers + low-sample warnings. ETA end of week. Any objections?
eli: :thumbsup: No objections. Please loop in product for UX sign-off @product-team.
maya: @product-team please review — intention is to show sample confidence and exclude low-sample deltas from SLO alerting rules by default.
deploy-bot: Created branch feat/dashboard-percentile-helpers.
maya: Link?
deploy-bot: https://git.company/repo/compare/feat/dashboard-percentile-helpers :eyes:
sam: I'll add unit tests for delta calculation and a doc note about sample semantics (how we treat small cohorts and delta confidence).
